q: Why use code execution against MCP tools for data-heavy tasks?
options: Large intermediate results stay in the sandbox and only the final answer enters the context
explain: Code keeps bulky data out of the model’s context.

q: With 8 tools per server at about 400 tokens each, roughly how many servers fill 10% of a 200,000-token window?
explain: Each server costs about 3,200 tokens; six servers are about 19,200 tokens, close to 10%.

q: What is a key benefit of an MCP gateway?
options: Central authentication, allowlists, credential injection and audit logs
It removes the need for servers
explain: Gateways put policy and credentials in one place.
